Being 'alaa' or high and elevated in the spiritual sense means working towards profound virtues such as kindness, wisdom, and self-discipline. For Muslims, the name Aleeyah is a reminder to constantly elevate one's inner spiritual being and seek the "highest good" of Allah. The name Aleeyah is thus an affirmation of a commitment towards ethical and moral growth, emulating the lifestyle of the prophets and messengers sent by Allah.
